Interface ResourceHandler

All Superinterfaces:
RequestHandler
All Known Subinterfaces:
StaticResources
public interface ResourceHandler extends RequestHandler
A RequestHandler that serves the resources under a URI prefix: it reads the path of the resource, relative to the prefix, from the path variable pathVariable(). HttpRouteSpec.resources(ResourceHandler) routes the prefix, and every path under it with that variable, to the handler. The static resources of the HTTP server, io.micronaut.http.server.routes.StaticResources, are one.

  • Method Details

    • pathVariable

      String pathVariable()
      The name of the path variable the handler reads the path of the resource from. The value is relative to the URI prefix, without a leading slash; the route of the prefix itself has no such variable.

      The route of the resources checks at startup that the variables of its prefix match one segment each, as far as it can: a regular expression cannot be proven to. A handler that resolves its resources from the path refuses a request whose other path variables are empty or have a slash, whose path of the resource is then not the end of the path of the request, as StaticResources does.

      Returns:
      The name of the path variable

    • blocking

      default boolean blocking()
      Whether reading the resources blocks, e.g. on the files of the file system or on the jars of the classpath: the routes of the resources then run on the blocking executor, unless the route or its groups declare an executor, see ExecutionSpec.executeOn(String) and ExecutionSpec.nonBlocking(). A handler that reads its resources without blocking, e.g. from memory, returns false: its routes run on the executor selected like for any RequestHandler.
      Returns:
      Whether reading the resources blocks, true by default
